policy: Allowlist for the optional third-party dependencies of a game repository made by the factory starter. tools/new_project.py --deps <bundle> writes exact pins from here (wally.toml entries use the semver '=' operator; rokit.toml tool pins are exact). The gate step `deps` (tools/check.py) refuses a Wally dependency that is not listed here at exactly this version, a missing or uncommitted wally.lock, a lock entry outside the allowlist, and a THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md that does not name every dependency and its licence. Nothing here is installed by the starter: `wally install` downloads code and is an owner step. Dependencies live in Packages/, ServerPackages/ and DevPackages/ (gitignored) and never inside packages/ (Lune cannot load Wally's instance-require linker modules). Versions, licences and sources were checked on 2026-10-06 (docs/research/gameplay-libraries-2026-10.md and tooling-2026-10.md in the factory).

lm-loleris/profilestore.notice: Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0 (https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0). The upstream repository ships the standard licence text in LICENSE and no NOTICE file (checked 2026-10-06); keep that LICENSE with any copy of the package you redistribute.
lm-loleris/profilestore.reason: Session-locked, auto-saving player profiles; wrapped by GameKit/PlayerData through injection (the module is passed in, never required by the kit).

jsdotlua/jest.notice: MIT licence (https://github.com/jsdotlua/jest-lua/blob/main/LICENSE). Dev-only: mapped by studio-tests.project.json, never by default.project.json.
jsdotlua/jest.reason: In-Studio tests for Roblox-API logic that Lune cannot run.

jsdotlua/jest-globals.reason: describe/it/expect globals for Jest Lua specs.

jsdotlua.why: Jest Lua 3.10.0 depends on further jsdotlua packages; wally.lock records their exact versions.

wally.note: Last release 2023-06-05; the registry still serves ProfileStore and Jest Lua. Wally's registry upload and login commands are never run here (private = true in wally.toml).

blink.note: Release v0.18.9 (19 Sep) ships blink-linux-x86_64.tar.xz (checked 2026-10-06); Rokit reads .tar.xz artifacts from 1.2.0. 0.18.9 fixed NaN values bypassing inexact range validation, so do not pin lower. Compiles *.blink schemas into validated remote code; no runtime library.

persistence.why: Player data with session locking (GameKit/PlayerData takes the ProfileStore module as a parameter).

studio-tests.why: Jest Lua specs that run inside Studio (studio-tests.project.json).

networking.why: Blink-compiled remotes (net/*.blink); the gate step `blink` compiles them.
